quality.title: Network quality
quality.description: Checks automatically when the page opens and samples every 30 seconds while it remains open.
quality.empty: Running the first network quality check…
quality.method: Six TCP connection probes run every 30 seconds while this page is open; sampling stops when you leave and uses no privileged raw packets.
quality.chartLabel: Network quality trend for the last 15 minutes with {{count}} samples

history.title: Connection history and aggregation
history.description: Review longer-term connection activity by application or domain.
history.optIn: Connection history can include application names, domains, and remote IPs, so it is off by default. When enabled, it stays on this device.
history.lookupFallback: Some names could not be resolved; IP addresses were recorded instead.
history.empty: Waiting for the next active connection scan.
history.privacy: Stores five-minute aggregates only, capped at 5,000 entries; disable or clear at any time.
